svg.aria-label: Isometric cutaway of a laboratory incubator. A rounded cream machine with a three-vent hood and a big front window holds a petri dish on a shelf under a marigold lamp; a thermometer with three zone bands stands inside. On the dish agar a small colony of cells: one hungry and cracked, a pair merging, and one opened to show its stomach vacuole, nucleus with DNA and a mitochondrion with cristae and marigold ATP tokens. Beside the incubator a frosted-glass chamber holds a sealed capsule. Drawn so a scroll camera can zoom from the machine down to one mitochondrion.
